identity.name: Fatih Serdar Çakmak
identity.motto: Defend the systems others depend on.

about: Computer Engineering student at Istanbul Technical University (class of 2027), with a background in Industrial Automation from Kocaeli ENKA Technical Schools. I got into cybersecurity through CTFs and never looked back. Did my first real SOC shift at Doğuş Teknoloji, where I went from filtering false positives to writing SOAR playbooks and tuning EDR alerts. Now I monitor live threats in a production banking environment at Fibabanka. I think in MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, dream in log queries, and believe the best defense is understanding the offense. When I'm not staring at SIEM dashboards, you'll find me exploring new attack vectors, contributing to open-source security tools, or doom-scrolling r/netsec.
